doc: The same with the closed-cell texture settings (low 12, slope 2 passed explicitly). Slope 2.0. The fBm white noise is the input plan0.white. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 6.7e-16, so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute (ndtr is a contraction: its slope is at most 0.4).
